note: SEED FILE. Entries below are transcribed from the X1 World / Cyberdyne log the owner supplied. Theo          overwrites this whole file on each publish — see NETFEED_CONTRACT.md.

entries.title: The 😂 Network handset lands in X1 City
entries.body: A carrier inside the game: relay towers on real rooftops, coverage that drops as you walk out of range,  and a phone with a number other citizens can call. No signal is a state, not a spinner.

entries.title: Jack confirms a 7-dev core team
entries.body: Confirmed in the X1 World bridges topic. What they are building is undisclosed.

entries.title: THORChain bridge on the table
entries.body:
Jack asked about using the teleporter with the THORChain bridge. Marat shared the v3.20 notes — XMR
  landing, ZEC next, SOL re-enabled.

entries.title: Conduct row rumbles on in Fight Club
entries.body:
A dispute over conduct standards. Jack was called on to address the community; no public response
  yet.
